label: space-in token detector
explanation: The feature fires reliably and strongly on the token `" in"` (space + "in"), which accounts for nearly all high-activation firings; it also fires weakly on many common function words as spillover. Strength is maximal on `" in"` itself, while other firings are generally weak or rare outliers. It is tied to the token form with a leading space, not the word "in" in general.
